DharmaNexus confirms substantial text reuse within the Pali canon, notably sharing 161 matching passages (19,418 characters) with the *Mahāpadāna Sutta* (DN 14), 86 matches with AN 4, as well as connections with the *Bākula Sutta* (MN 124), the Vinaya *Mahākhandhaka* (Kd 1), and various Saṁyutta discourses [DharmaNexus]. Beyond Pali, DharmaNexus identifies textual alignments in Chinese (notably the *Dīrghāgama*, T 1, and the *Seven Buddhas Sūtra*, T 2), Sanskrit parallels (such as the *Mahāvadānasūtra*, *Saṅghabhedavastu*, and *Mahāparinirvāṇasūtra*), and Tibetan parallels (including the *Abhiniṣkramaṇasūtra*, D 301) [DharmaNexus].
